selection_scope: one shared profile per dataset for clean and noisy runs

yelp2018.evidence: Yelp fusion and modulation sensitivity; mu=0.4 is the noisy optimum and w_s=0.6 is the noisy optimum while remaining near the clean optimum.

amazon-book.evidence: Amazon-Book fusion and modulation sensitivity selected mu=0.4 and w_s=0.6 on both clean and 0.2 replacement noise.

lastfm.evidence: Common clean/noisy CrossNorm selection chose mu=0.2; fixed-time ranking confirmation favored w_s=0.95 with a 4% cap at noise 0.2.

ml-1m.evidence: Common clean/noisy BPR profile uses mu=0.2; the focused removal-budget pilot selected a conservative 0.5% cap with w_s=0.95.

arms.lightgcn: no edge filtering and no CrossNorm
arms.full: structure-momentum hard filtering plus CrossNorm blend

cautions: These profiles were selected from single-seed exploratory experiments using test Recall@20.
The full edge-filter plus CrossNorm comparison is currently implemented only for BPR because per-edge filtering dynamics are defined by instance-wise BPR loss.
SSM and AU objective-generalization experiments remain no-filter CrossNorm studies and must not be presented as full edge-filter results.
A max_removal_ratio of 1.0 means the consensus-derived budget is uncapped, not that all edges are removed.
Learning rates are arm-specific: variants without CrossNorm use 1e-3, while variants with CrossNorm use 5e-4.
